name: wan3.0-video
description: Wan 3.0 is an all-in-one video generation model that unifies reference-based generation, editing, recreation, and motion driving in a single system. It supports versatile referencing across four modalities, generates videos up to 30 seconds long, and can interpret files, web pages, and complex images. With production-grade character consistency and realistic audio-visual output, it delivers a highly immersive viewing experience.
zhDescription: 万相3.0是 all-in-one 视频生成模型，统一支持参考、编辑、复刻、驱动等多种创作功能，四模态全能参考，最长支持30秒视频生成，可解析文件、网页及复杂图片。生产级角色一致性保持，音画真实，带来身临其境的视听冲击力。
longDescription: Wan 3.0 is an all-in-one video generation model that unifies reference-based generation, editing, recreation, and motion driving in a single system. It supports versatile referencing across four modalities, generates videos up to 30 seconds long, and can interpret files, web pages, and complex images. With production-grade character consistency and realistic audio-visual output, it delivers a highly immersive viewing experience.
zhLongDescription: 万相3.0是 all-in-one 视频生成模型，统一支持参考、编辑、复刻、驱动等多种创作功能，四模态全能参考，最长支持30秒视频生成，可解析文件、网页及复杂图片。生产级角色一致性保持，音画真实，带来身临其境的视听冲击力。
